reasoning_trace.label: valid

reasoning_trace.label: valid

reasoning_trace.label: valid

final_answer: Rule: among ready tasks, dispatch a flagged (*) task next (smallest-weight flagged if several); otherwise dispatch the smallest-weight ready task. Query order: o, m, n.
